notes.title: Demo updated, release approaching
notes.notes:
We want to thank all the players that tested the demo and provided us with awesome feedback during Steam Next Fest last month.

We are working hard to prepare for the full release - on the 25th - and are updating the demo accordingly. It's not longer than before, but all the issues you found should have been fixed.

A big shoutout to the streamers that took time to play the demo, it's always a stressful yet heartwarming  moment for the team, and it was a lot of fun.


 eddyratt_tv
 intelligame
 The_Jenna
 Erin_Grey


See you in 10 days!
